summary: MasterBrand, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing board actions related to its pending merger with American Woodmark Corporation under a previously announced Agreement and Plan of Merger. The MasterBrand board increased its size from eight to eleven directors and appointed three American Woodmark designees (Andrew Cogan, Philip Fracassa, Daniel Hendrix) effective at closing. No deal price, premium, or advisor was stated. The merger is expected to close in Q2 2026, pending regulatory clearance. Watch for regulatory approval timing; risk-arb focus is on closing conditions and potential antitrust review.
